Chest x-ray: pulmonary vascular congestion, small bilateral effusions

notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed. 64-year-old female admitted for community-acquired pneumonia. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.45, bnp 1055, creatinine 1.06, hemoglobin 13.3, platelets 306, sodium 139, wbc 9.4; vitals dbp 74-78, heart_rate 71-76, map 94-98, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 14-15, sbp 133-139, spo2 94-95, temp 36.6-36.9
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Chest x-ray: pulmonary vascular congestion, small bilateral effusions; Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity; Furosemide 40 mg IV; Transthoracic echo: LVEF 30%, global hypokinesis
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. COPD. Hypertension. Acute systolic heart failure.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Patient seen and examined at bedside. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 1.01, hemoglobin 13.5, platelets 302, sodium 138, wbc 9.4; vitals dbp 74-78, heart_rate 71-74, map 93-98, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 14-15, sbp 132-139, spo2 94-95, temp 36.7-36.9
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Furosemide 40 mg IV
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. COPD. Hypertension. Acute systolic heart failure. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 64-year-old female, length of stay 5 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Community-acquired pneumonia. COPD. Hypertension. Acute systolic heart failure. Follow up with primary care in one week. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed.
